name: CharacterExpression
description: Mascot character illustrations expressing emotions. 40 variants across 14 emotion categories. Used in empty states, loading screens, confirmations, and modal body (ModalContent). Each is a 128×128px illustration.

type.description: Expression variant. Numbers indicate animation alternatives within the same emotion.

emotionMap.think: Thoughtful / processing — use on AI generation loading
emotionMap.tutor: Explaining / teaching — use on help/onboarding screens
emotionMap.calm: Neutral / relaxed — use on success confirmation
emotionMap.no-idea: Confused / unsure — use on error or unknown state
emotionMap.info: Informative — use on info tooltips or guidance modals
emotionMap.hidden: Hiding / shy — use on empty state (no data)
emotionMap.success: Happy / celebrating — use on task completed
emotionMap.love: Friendly / approving — use on onboarding welcome
emotionMap.no: Declining / refusing — use on permission denied
emotionMap.search: Looking / searching — use on search empty state
emotionMap.other-photo: Photo-related — use on image upload empty state

usage.notes: Export as SVG or PNG from Figma. Use inside ModalContent(Default) center slot, empty state views, or page-level error screens. Always pair with a text message.

aria.aria-hidden: true — decorative; pair with visible text message

do: Match the expression to the emotional tone of the message.
Use multiple variants (e.g. think-1, think-2) for variety across different screens.
dont: Don't use a happy expression for error states.
